intro: This task requires shutting down the intricate machinery powering the Venture Company's digging operations in the northern Barrens. By cutting off three separate control valves, adventurers can safely power down the central apparatus. Turning off these valves halts the volatile flow of fuel and pressure keeping the machine active.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
